newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange on Friday. No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- One barge, Ohio (Cincinnati-Aurora) next week, bid at 105 percent of tariff, no offer or comparison.
- One barge, Ohio (Jeffersonville) next week, bid at 105 percent of tariff, no offer or comparison.
- 2 barges, Mississippi (St. Louis) next week, no bid or comparison, offered at 105 percent of tariff.
- One barge, Mississippi River (Oceola-Cairo) next week, bid at 92.5 percent of tariff, no offer or comparison.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week February, no bid or comparsion, offered at 175 percent of tariff.
- Four barges, Mississippi (Oceola-Cairo) one each week Feb., no bid or comparison, offered 100 percent of tariff.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi, scattered even, 15 day open, bid at 160 percent of tariff, no offer or comparison.
- Five barges, mid-Mississippi, scattered even, 30 day open, bid unchanged at at 155 percent and offered unchanged at 165 percent of tariff.
